facecam.name: Auto (per stream)
facecam.desc: The tool checks this stream's own frames and picks the freest corner — avoids the HUD and the streamer's own facecam. Default.

facecam.name: Stage (new)
facecam.desc: The new layout — small facecam top-centre with a golden frame, big gameplay filling the frame, captions over blurred gameplay at the bottom. The finalized look.

facecam.name: Stage — no facecam
facecam.desc: Same stage look but no facecam — gameplay fills the full frame, captions over blurred gameplay at the bottom. For streamers without a webcam.

facecam.name: Stage — facecam top-left
facecam.desc: Stage structure, facecam in the top-LEFT of the top band (gold-framed) — big gameplay below, captions over the blurred zone at the bottom.

facecam.name: Stage — facecam top-right
facecam.desc: Stage structure, facecam in the top-RIGHT of the top band (gold-framed) — big gameplay below, captions over the blurred zone at the bottom.

facecam.name: Stage — facecam mid-left
facecam.desc: Stage structure, facecam on the MID-LEFT side (gold-framed), gameplay fills the full frame behind it — captions over the blurred zone at the bottom.

facecam.name: Top-right corner
facecam.desc: PeakCut-like corner — the streamer's face, bigger than PeakCut (40% of width).

facecam.name: Top-left corner
facecam.desc: Mirror of top-right — for streams whose top-right has a HUD or logo.

facecam.name: Mid-right
facecam.desc: Right side, vertically centred — below the top HUD, above the caption band.

facecam.name: Mid-left
facecam.desc: Left side, vertically centred — same as mid-right, other side.

facecam.name: Bottom-left
facecam.desc: Bottom-left corner, above the platform UI strip — captions move up to clear it.

facecam.name: Bottom-right
facecam.desc: Bottom-right corner, above the platform UI strip — captions move up to clear it.

facecam.name: Top band (full width)
facecam.desc: Clipie-style: the facecam stretches across the whole top as a band (50% by default, 30% option), gameplay fills below it.

facecam.name: Bottom band (full width)
facecam.desc: Facecam as a band across the whole bottom (50% by default, 30% option) — captions move up to the seam above it.

facecam.name: Off (no facecam)
facecam.desc: No facecam overlay at all — just the game, full frame.

caption.name: Auto (first free line)
caption.desc: The tool checks the facecam + HUD and picks the first free line: bottom, then higher. Default.

caption.name: Bottom band (y~950-1000)
caption.desc: Text at y~950-1000 — below the action centre, above the platforms' own UI. sohaib's verdict, the default.

caption.name: Seam (below the facecam band)
caption.desc: Text just below the top-band facecam (Clipie-style seam). Best with the top-band facecam.

caption.name: Top
caption.desc: Text at the very top of the frame — for when the bottom is busy (HUD, subtitles in the game).

caption.name: Stage — bottom
caption.desc: Stage captions in the blurred zone at the bottom — text y~995-1065, below the action centre, above the platforms’ own UI. The default stage caption.

caption.name: Stage — top
caption.desc: Stage captions just below the facecam band — text y~245-315 over a blurred gameplay strip, game fills below.

frame.name: Golden Comet
frame.desc: Golden light travelling around the frame — the original, calm 4s lap. Default.

frame.name: Red Comet
frame.desc: PeakCut-style hype red comet travelling around the frame, 4s lap.

frame.name: Cyan Line
frame.desc: A bright cyan line sweeping around the frame — no comet blob, just the line, 4s lap.

frame.name: Fire Ember
frame.desc: Orange fire ember with a strong flicker and a long tail travelling around the frame, 4s lap.

frame.name: Clean Static
frame.desc: No motion at all — a clean thin white/silver border, the minimal look.

frame.name: Violet Pulse
frame.desc: A violet neon ring that breathes in and out — no travelling light, 2s cycle.

frame.name: Circle
frame.desc: Facecam cropped to a circle with a thin gold ring and a travelling light — no box at all, the round look.

frame.name: Clean (no frame)
frame.desc: No border at all — just a soft drop shadow under the facecam, the minimal floating look.

frame.name: Bold Chunky
frame.desc: A much thicker chunky border (10px) instead of the thin line — the heavy frame look.

frame.name: Viewfinder Corners
frame.desc: Viewfinder style — only the four corner brackets, no full border.

frame.name: Big Facecam
frame.desc: A larger facecam (360x203) with a thin gold frame — the streamer front and centre.
